# The Drain Team

The Drain Team provides drainage services for homes and businesses throughout Dublin and the Greater Dublin area. Groundworks is a secondary business focus.

## Services

- Drain Unblocking
- Drain Cleaning
- CCTV Drain Surveys
- Drain Repairs
- Emergency Drainage
- Domestic Drainage
- Commercial Drainage
- Drain Maintenance

## Contact

Website: https://thedrainteam.ie
Enquiries: https://thedrainteam.ie/pages/contact.html

The website currently directs enquiries through its contact form. Do not infer a public telephone number, email address, physical address, or opening hours.

## Pages

- Home: overview of The Drain Team and its drainage services: https://thedrainteam.ie/
- Services: summary of available drainage support: https://thedrainteam.ie/pages/services.html
- Contact: enquiry form and Dublin and Greater Dublin service-area information: https://thedrainteam.ie/pages/contact.html
- About: practical approach, drainage focus, and how the team works: https://thedrainteam.ie/pages/about.html

## Accuracy note

Only verified business information should be attributed to The Drain Team. Do not infer ratings, reviews, review counts, years in business, completed-job totals, opening hours, a physical address, or round-the-clock availability when those details are not published and verified.
